reporting_rule: Use the first three complete cyclically rotated repetitions. Repetition 3 was interrupted before producing a summary; no partial arm is included.

selection.rule: retain the 99 largest valid PDFs plus every other valid PDF with pages <= 23; preserve frozen manifest order
selection.warning: The benchmark reads the manifest, not the PDF bytes. source_pdf_bytes describes the selected source files and is not processed-byte throughput.

conditions.poison_rule: page 0 of each retained top-99 PDF

nominal_opportunity.warning: R*B is a workload-design heuristic, not a strict global inflight bound.

timing.v36_input: parent records; timed Parent->Page expansion, expensive work, and parent reduce
timing.ray_data_and_daft_input: balanced pre-expanded page records constructed outside the timed region
timing.interpretation: The competitor input accommodation is deliberately conservative in their favor.

workload_scope.expensive_udf: 50 ms sleep per non-poison page while a one-GPU actor allocation is held
workload_scope.does_measure: scheduler wall time, physical UDF admissions, READY suppression, and late-commit isolation
workload_scope.does_not_measure: GPU SM utilization, energy, PDF rasterization, or real MinerU OCR throughput
